property_summary: For any caller address X and newOwner address Y, in the correct contract only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership (so if the call succeeds then c.owner() == Y), whereas the mutant inverts the check and allows non-owners to call (and blocks the owner), so there exist inputs where transferOwnership succeeds in the mutant but would be disallowed in the reference (causing owner to differ).
change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner); with require(msg.sender != owner); so onlyOwner allows non-owners and blocks the owner, changing who can call transferOwnership.
